objective: Preallocate bare aggregate fallback buffers from known aggregate and projection counts.

tasks.title: Preallocate bare aggregate fallback buffers
tasks.result: Bare aggregate fallback now preallocates accumulator, aggregate map, and result row buffers from known input sizes.

notes: Cargo/linker verification used an E: workspace temp directory because the default C:/TEMP drive was full.
The change preserves accumulator initialization order, aggregate finalization, expression-to-value mapping, projection result order, and error propagation.
